description: Inspect frosted shutters with the lantern, then guide drifting couriers through their revealed moving apertures using the same lantern and one fading photograph.
name: The Unwatched Wing V3 · Difficulty 4 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Bring every sleeping courier to the archive. Frosted survey glass conceals each shutter’s opening, eye, trail and motion dials. Aim the lantern at its visible brass survey plate to inspect it; that shutter’s live view then stays available. Inspect before a courier reaches it. Each accepted lantern control, including inspection, advances one fixed 400 ms action step; waiting between controls leaves the wing stable. The survey glass changes only the view, not physical contact. The lantern pins one nearby object; one photograph keeps its pictured object pinned until the image fades. Every unrestrained courier advances and drifts vertically during each fixed 400 ms action step after a deliberate lantern or photo control; waiting between controls leaves the wing stable. Light and photographs stop both its coordinates. Every other object keeps moving. Hold aligned shutters or stop couriers to wait; shutter contact ends the attempt. Trails show the recent 0.4 seconds. Arrows use a one-second speed scale; dashed arrows show immediate release drift. Faint tracks mark the swing limits. Current motion dials show angle, angular speed and forward speed. Dials also show whether each rate is rising or falling. Rates step every 0.2 seconds and reflect at the visible limits, including while restrained. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload, navigation, browser extensions, external applications, implementation or hidden-state access. Do not interact with pre-existing, unrelated, blank, browser-settings or non-task tabs. Only tabs opened by a visible task control and belonging to the task may be used, through their visible controls.
